sections.heading: Why We Built ScaleAndFit
paragraphs: Most measurement tools online bury simple answers behind pop-ups, slow file uploads, or vague approximations. ScaleAndFit brings four everyday physical calibration tools into one fast, clear workspace designed so anyone can get a reliable answer in seconds.
Every pixel, millimeter, and PDF page point is calculated mathematically inside your browser — from international banking card width (85.60 mm) to official 300-DPI passport ovals.

sections.heading: International Standards Used
list: Passport & Visa Photos (ICAO Doc 9303): Calculates 300 pixels per inch (11.811 px/mm) output canvases and target crown-to-chin ratios across 90 .
Printable Vector PDFs (72 PostScript pt/in): Writes true geometric coordinates into clean PDF vectors using ISO A4 (210 × 297 mm) and US Letter (215.9 × 279.4 mm).
Shoe Sizing (ISO 9407 Mondopoint): Translates US, UK, and Paris-Point EU sizes through canonical foot length in millimeters plus brand last offsets.
Ring Sizing (ISO 8653 & ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1): Uses a real 85.60 × 53.98 mm card reference to eliminate display DPI distortion on phones, laptops, and monitors.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller & Contact
paragraphs: ScaleAndFit.com is operated by OTHRYS Systems. For privacy questions or data inquiries, contact us at othrys.systems@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 2. Local In-Browser Processing (GDPR & CCPA)
paragraphs: When you load a portrait in Passport Photo Studio, type addresses into Avery Labels, capture a frame from your camera, or measure a ring, all processing occurs exclusively in client-side JavaScript memory. No personal portrait files or form data are transmitted to or stored on ScaleAndFit servers.

sections.heading: 3. Browser Preferences (localStorage)
paragraphs: We save at most two strictly functional preference keys locally in your browser: sf-theme (only when Dark / Carbon mode is turned on) and sf-lang (your selected language preference). Neither key contains personal identifiers or crosses domains.

sections.heading: 4. Network Delivery & Security Logs
paragraphs: Static HTML, scripts, and images are delivered globally via Cloudflare Workers Edge. Like all standard web servers, Cloudflare temporarily processes basic connection metadata (such as IP request logs for DDoS and TLS security protection) under Cloudflare's infrastructure privacy safeguards.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
paragraphs: Because ScaleAndFit collects no user accounts, portrait archives, or behavioral profiles, clearing your browser site storage removes any saved local theme or language choice immediately. You may also contact othrys.systems@gmail.com anytime.
